sources.evidence: Cross-Cloud Interconnect is a product that helps you establish high-bandwidth dedicated connectivity between Google Cloud and another cloud service provider.

sources.title: Choosing a Network Connectivity product
sources.evidence: If you need to connect to another cloud service provider, choose Cross-Cloud Interconnect.

sources.title: Cross-Cloud Interconnect overview
sources.evidence: When you buy Cross-Cloud Interconnect, Google provisions a dedicated physical connection between the Google network and that of another cloud service provider.

stem: KnightMotives stores corporate data in many BigQuery datasets and Cloud Storage buckets across business units. The data remains siloed, and analysts cannot find trusted data or see where it came from. Before KnightMotives monetizes data, it needs a data management platform across these stores. What should you recommend?

options.text: Keep a shared spreadsheet that lists each dataset and bucket, with owners and descriptions that teams update by hand.
Use Knowledge Catalog (formerly Dataplex Universal Catalog) to discover assets, check data quality, and trace data lineage.
Copy all datasets into one central BigQuery project each night, so that analysts search in one place.
Use Cloud Asset Inventory to search the metadata of all BigQuery datasets and Cloud Storage buckets.

explanation: The deciding needs are discovery, trust in data quality, and knowledge of where data came from. Knowledge Catalog helps teams discover assets and verify data quality across structured and unstructured data. Its data lineage traces column-level transformations across pipelines. Knowledge Catalog is the new name of Dataplex Universal Catalog.

whyWrong.A: A manual list goes out of date quickly, and it gives no data quality checks or lineage.
whyWrong.C: Nightly copies make more copies of sensitive data and add cost. They also give no data quality checks or lineage.
whyWrong.D: Cloud Asset Inventory is a metadata inventory of Google Cloud assets for tasks such as compliance tracking and audits. It does not check data quality or trace lineage.

sources.title: Knowledge Catalog overview
sources.evidence: By building a dynamic context graph from structured and unstructured data, it helps data teams and developers discover assets, verify data quality, and securely ground generative AI applications to reduce hallucinations.

sources.title: Knowledge Catalog overview
sources.evidence: Data lineage. Trace column-level transformations across pipelines to track where your data comes from and how it has changed.

sources.title: Knowledge Catalog release notes
sources.evidence: Dataplex Universal Catalog is now called Knowledge Catalog. The API, client library, CLI, and Identity and Access Management (IAM) names remain unchanged.

stem: KnightMotives must build a simulation environment for autonomous vehicle development and testing. Each simulation run splits into many independent tasks, and a failed task can restart from the beginning. The team wants the lowest compute cost. It does not want to manage a job scheduler or provision VMs itself. What should you recommend?

options.text: Run the tasks as Batch jobs on Spot VMs, and configure automatic retries for tasks that fail on preemption.
Run the tasks on standard VMs, and install a third-party job scheduler on a separate VM to queue them.
Run the tasks in a managed instance group of Spot VMs, and restart failed tasks by hand each morning.
Buy 3-year committed use discounts for enough standard VMs to run all tasks at peak load.

explanation: The deciding needs are independent, restartable tasks, the lowest cost, and no scheduler to manage. Batch schedules, queues, and runs batch work, so the team does not manage a job scheduler or provision resources. Spot VMs reduce cost for fault-tolerant work that can withstand preemption. Automatic task retries suit independent tasks and can recover from Spot VM preemption.

whyWrong.B: Standard VMs cost more than Spot VMs for fault-tolerant work. The team must also manage the scheduler, which the requirement does not allow.
whyWrong.C: Manual restarts add toil and delay results. The team also manages the task queue itself.
whyWrong.D: A 3-year commitment for peak capacity pays for VMs that sit idle between runs. Spot VMs cost less for fault-tolerant tasks.

sources.title: Get started with Batch
sources.evidence: Using Batch, you don't need to configure and manage third-party job schedulers, provision and deprovision resources, or request resources one zone at a time.

sources.title: Spot VMs
sources.evidence: If your workloads are fault-tolerant and can withstand possible VM preemption, Spot VMs can reduce your Compute Engine costs significantly. For example, batch processing jobs can run on Spot VMs.

sources.title: Automate task retries
sources.evidence: Automatic retries are well-suited to loosely coupled (independent) tasks and can help with a variety of issues.

stem: KnightMotives's current AI infrastructure is obsolete. The autonomous driving team plans a distributed training run on clustered GPUs. The run starts on a fixed date and lasts about three weeks. It needs assured, densely allocated capacity for the whole run. The company does not want a commitment of one year or longer. Which consumption option should you recommend?

options.text: Flex-start VMs, requested on the start date of the training run
Spot VMs, with training checkpoints saved to Cloud Storage every hour
Future reservations for capacity blocks, with a one-year resource-based commitment
A future reservation in calendar mode for the three weeks of the run

explanation: The deciding needs are assured, dense capacity for a fixed period of about three weeks, with no long commitment. Future reservations in calendar mode serve clustered GPU workloads of up to 90 days that require reserved capacity. You request resources for a set period, and you have exclusive access to them for that time.

whyWrong.A: Flex-start capacity is best-effort, and Google positions it for workloads of up to seven days. The run lasts about three weeks and needs assured capacity.
whyWrong.B: Spot VMs are preemptible, and their capacity is best-effort. Checkpoints reduce lost work, but they do not assure capacity.
whyWrong.C: The one-year commitment breaks the stated limit. Google positions capacity blocks for large-scale, long-running training.

sources.title: Consumption options for AI Hypercomputer
sources.evidence: clustered GPU workloads up to 90 days that require reserved capacity.

sources.title: Consumption options for AI Hypercomputer
sources.evidence: To run short-running distributed workloads that require densely allocated resources, you can request compute resources for up to 90 days.

stem: KnightMotives's service technicians and sales staff need better tooling to find answers in service manuals, bulletins, and dealer procedures. These documents are in Microsoft SharePoint and Confluence, and some are restricted to certain roles. Dealers have no budget for new equipment. What should you recommend?

options.text: Deploy Gemini Enterprise with its prebuilt SharePoint and Confluence connectors, so staff get permissions-aware search.
Build a custom retrieval app on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI), and host its vector index on GKE.
Upload all manuals each month to one shared Gemini Notebook Enterprise (formerly NotebookLM Enterprise) notebook for all staff.
Give each dealer tablets with an offline app that stores a local copy of all service manuals and procedures.

explanation: The deciding needs are search across SharePoint and Confluence, respect for document restrictions, and no new equipment. Gemini Enterprise includes prebuilt connectors for Confluence and Microsoft SharePoint. It gives employees one search interface with permissions-aware access to enterprise information. Staff use it through web and mobile apps.

whyWrong.B: A custom app can work, but KnightMotives must build and operate the app and its GKE cluster. The prebuilt connectors already meet the need.
whyWrong.C: A notebook uses only the sources that users add, so monthly copies go stale. The copies also move restricted documents out of their source systems.
whyWrong.D: New tablets are new equipment, and dealers have no budget for them. Local copies also go out of date.

sources.title: What is Gemini Enterprise?
sources.evidence: Gemini Enterprise includes prebuilt connectors for commonly-used third-party applications like Confluence, Jira, Microsoft SharePoint, and ServiceNow.

sources.title: What is Gemini Enterprise?
sources.evidence: This provides employees with a single, multimodal search interface offering permissions-aware access to enterprise information.

sources.title: What is Gemini Enterprise?
sources.evidence: Search enterprise data, collaborate, and interact with AI assistants and agents using the web and mobile apps.

stem: Security is a paramount concern for KnightMotives because of past data breaches. The company is moving corporate data to BigQuery and Cloud Storage. The security team wants threat detection across the Google Cloud organization. It also wants to reduce the risk of data exfiltration from these services. Which two actions should you take? (Choose two.)

options.text: Grant the security team the Owner role on every project, so that it can respond to threats quickly.
Activate Security Command Center Premium at the organization level for threat detection and attack paths.
Attach Cloud Armor security policies to the BigQuery and Cloud Storage projects to block data exfiltration.
Create a VPC Service Controls perimeter around the projects that hold the BigQuery and Cloud Storage data.
Store service account keys in a shared Cloud Storage bucket, and rotate the keys each week.

explanation: The deciding needs are threat detection across the organization and protection against data exfiltration. The Security Command Center Premium tier adds threat detection and attack paths, and you can activate it at the organization level. VPC Service Controls helps reduce data exfiltration risks from services such as Cloud Storage and BigQuery.

whyWrong.A: The Owner role gives far more access than detection needs. A stolen security account would then control every project.
whyWrong.C: Cloud Armor helps protect applications and services from DDoS and web-based attacks. It does not control who can copy data out of BigQuery or Cloud Storage.
whyWrong.E: A shared bucket exposes the keys to everyone who can read it. Weekly rotation does not detect threats or stop exfiltration.

sources.title: Security Command Center service tiers
sources.evidence: Premium. Everything in Standard, plus advanced security and compliance posture management, attack paths, threat detection, and compliance monitoring for Google Cloud only. The Premium tier can be activated at the project or organization level.

sources.title: Overview of VPC Service Controls
sources.evidence: VPC Service Controls helps protect against accidental or targeted action by external entities or insider entities, which helps to minimize unwarranted data exfiltration risks from Google Cloud services such as Cloud Storage and BigQuery.

stem: KnightMotives will run parts of its autonomous platform on Google Cloud for EU customers. Adherence to EU data protection regulations is critical. The legal team requires EU-only data locations, and support access only by support personnel based in the EU. The team wants predefined controls instead of custom configuration. What should you recommend?

options.text: Create an Assured Workloads folder with the EU Data Boundary control package.
Create an Assured Workloads folder with the EU Data Boundary and Support control package.
Set the resource locations organization policy constraint on the folder to allow only EU locations.
Create Cloud Storage buckets in EU regions, and encrypt the data with customer-managed encryption keys.

explanation: The deciding needs are EU-only data locations and support by personnel based in the EU, with predefined controls. Assured Workloads applies predefined control packages to folders. The EU Data Boundary and Support package sets data location controls for EU-only regions. It also sets support access controls to EU support personnel based in the EU.

whyWrong.A: The EU Data Boundary package sets data location controls only. The support access requirement needs a package that also sets support controls.
whyWrong.C: The constraint limits where new resources are created. It has no controls for support access, and it is custom configuration.
whyWrong.D: Bucket location and CMEK cover only Cloud Storage and encryption. They do not control support access or the location of other services.

sources.title: Control packages
sources.evidence: The EU Data Boundary and Support control package sets data location controls to support EU-only regions. Support access controls are set to EU support personnel based in the EU

sources.title: Overview of Assured Workloads
sources.evidence: You can use Assured Workloads to simplify management and configuration of regulated workloads by applying predefined control packages to folders.

stem: KnightMotives prioritizes employee upskilling and better communication between business and technical teams. Leaders do not know which cloud skills their teams lack. They also do not know how strongly leadership supports the move to the cloud. They want a structured way to find the gaps before they plan training. What should you recommend?

options.text: Outsource all cloud work to a partner, so that internal teams do not need new cloud skills.
Let engineers learn during production incidents, and plan formal training after the first major outage.
Assess readiness with the Google Cloud Adoption Framework, including its Learn and Lead themes, and then plan training.
Buy certification exam vouchers for all engineers, and skip the readiness assessment to save time.

explanation: The deciding need is a structured way to find skill and leadership gaps. The Google Cloud Adoption Framework assesses your readiness for Google Cloud and what you must do to fill the gaps. Its Learn theme covers the quality and scale of learning programs. Its Lead theme covers the mandate from leadership to migrate.

whyWrong.A: Outsourcing does not build internal skills, and the case makes upskilling a critical objective.
whyWrong.B: Learning during incidents adds risk to production, and it gives no structured view of the gaps.
whyWrong.D: Vouchers without an assessment do not show which skills are missing. They also do not measure leadership support.

sources.evidence: You can use this framework to assess your organization's readiness for Google Cloud and what you need to do to fill in the gaps and develop new competencies, as illustrated in the following diagram.

stem: KnightMotives's supply chain runs on an outdated mainframe, and reporting jobs use a large share of mainframe CPU. The data team wants to move mainframe data to Google Cloud and run the reports in BigQuery. The existing batch jobs are defined in JCL, and the team wants to keep scheduling them on the mainframe for now. What should you recommend?

options.text: Export the mainframe data to CSV files by hand each week, and upload the files to Cloud Storage.
Use Database Migration Service to replicate the mainframe data into a Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL instance.
Use Storage Transfer Service to copy the mainframe datasets directly into BigQuery tables.
Call Mainframe Connector from the existing JCL batch jobs to move data to Cloud Storage and BigQuery.

explanation: The deciding needs are to offload reports to BigQuery and to keep the JCL batch jobs. Mainframe Connector moves mainframe data to Google Cloud so that you can offload CPU-intensive report workloads. It lets you submit BigQuery jobs from mainframe batch jobs defined in JCL.

whyWrong.A: Manual weekly exports are slow and error-prone. They also break the link to the scheduled JCL jobs.
whyWrong.B: The reports must run in BigQuery, not Cloud SQL. This option also does not use the existing JCL batch jobs.
whyWrong.C: Storage Transfer Service moves data to Cloud Storage or to on-premises storage, not into BigQuery tables. It also does not run from the JCL batch jobs.

sources.title: Mainframe Connector overview
sources.evidence: Mainframe Connector lets you move your mainframe data to Google Cloud so that you can offload CPU-intensive report workloads to Google Cloud.

sources.title: Mainframe Connector overview
sources.evidence: Batch job integration: Lets you submit BigQuery jobs using mainframe batch jobs defined in job control language (JCL).

sources.title: Mainframe Connector overview
sources.evidence: Simplified data transfer: Simplifies the movement of mainframe data to Google Cloud storage services like Cloud Storage and BigQuery.

stem: KnightMotives must develop an incident response plan as part of its focus on security and risk management. In past incidents, nobody knew who led the response, and the same problems came back. The company wants a process that improves after each incident. What should you recommend?

options.text: Let each team handle incidents in its own way, and send a summary to leadership each quarter.
Record the name of the engineer at fault in each incident report, so that accountability is clear.
Define incident roles and escalation paths in a runbook, and hold a blameless post-incident review after each incident.
Close each incident as soon as service is restored, and skip reviews so that engineers return to planned work.

explanation: The deciding needs are clear ownership during incidents and learning after them. Google recommends that you define roles such as incident commander, and document procedures in a runbook. After an incident, a post-incident review finds the root cause and lessons learned. A blameless culture keeps the focus on learning instead of blame.

whyWrong.A: Separate processes leave roles unclear across teams. A quarterly summary is too late to prevent repeat problems.
whyWrong.B: Blame discourages open reporting. Google recommends a blameless culture that focuses on learning and improvement.
whyWrong.D: Without a review, the team never finds the root cause, so the same problems come back.

sources.title: Manage incidents and problems
sources.evidence: To establish incident response procedures, you need to define the roles and expectations of each team member, such as incident commanders, investigators, communicators, and technical experts.

sources.title: Manage incidents and problems
sources.evidence: By documenting incident response procedures in a runbook or playbook, you can provide a standardized reference guide for teams to follow during an incident.

sources.title: Manage incidents and problems
sources.evidence: To ensure a successful PIR process, your organization must foster a blameless culture that focuses on learning and improvement rather than assigning blame.
